rules.rulespeak_statement: The Visa Application must be made in the prescribed manner.

rules.rulespeak_statement: The Visa is not defined as an entitlement available as of right.

rules.rulespeak_statement: Personal Information must be collected only for a lawful Agency purpose and where necessary for that purpose.

candidate_inventory_appendix_e.governance_treatment: Education Code rules verified where applicable; immigration product link requires reconciliation.

candidate_inventory_appendix_e.content: Partner visitor/work and dependent-child pathways linked to qualification level, including candidate level 7/8, masters and PhD branches.
candidate_inventory_appendix_e.governance_treatment: RelatedVisa and SupportEligibility nodes; source coverage gap.

candidate_inventory_appendix_e.content: Maintain valid visa, authorised provider/programme, attendance, progress, insurance, work conditions and approval before changes.
candidate_inventory_appendix_e.governance_treatment: Connect obligations to actual visa-condition record; do not assume standard conditions.

candidate_inventory_appendix_e.content: Candidate effective dates and supersession, including work-right changes.
candidate_inventory_appendix_e.governance_treatment: Every product rule requires effective_from, effective_to, source version and supersession edges.
